comments.text:
Bro sorry to hear about the experiences. Please try to avoid new india insurance as I personally got this one. 
So my issue was very similar to yours as I was riding my cb350 highness and the back wheel got in a pothole resulting in a rim bend.
So when I tried to claim the insurance, I had to go here and there to the insurance offices and honda bigwing service centre multiple times. I was really fed up with the whole experience as the whole process took around 2 months to complete. I contacted the assigned person multiple times throughout the process but all I kept hearing was "Ki ho jayega aap chinta mt karo" till 2 months. But eventually I got claim for it, but I was sure to never go into this insurance again.
